name: LOGIC ERP
description_en:
LOGIC ERP is a product family for retail, distribution and manufacturing with billing, stock and financial functions. Its official site separates cloud and on-premise offers; the cloud pricing matrix is a particular offer rather than a universal price for the whole family.

The workflow examined here is buying in one unit, selling in another and retaining lot/serial, location and return information. This documentation review did not install a product, connect a tax service or execute a stock transaction.
description_zh:
LOGIC ERP 是面向零售、分销和制造的产品家族，包含开票、库存和财务。官网区分云端与本地方案，云定价表只对应特定方案，不能作为整个家族通用价格。

本文研究按一种单位采购、另一种单位销售，并保留批次序列号、地点和退货信息的流程；未安装产品、连接税务服务或执行库存交易。

core_features.explanation_en: Inventory descriptions include carton/box/dozen conversions and size/shade item matrices.
core_features.explanation_zh: 库存说明包含箱盒打的单位转换，以及尺码色号矩阵。

core_features.explanation_en: The page describes lot/serial stock, expiry prompts and supplier returns for expired or damaged goods.
core_features.explanation_zh: 页面介绍批次序列号库存、到期提醒，以及过期损坏品退供应商。

pricing.billing_basis: Specific regional cloud tiers billed yearly; license quantity, implementation and on-premise quote require confirmation; add-ons separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Basic from INR 1,638/month equivalent billed yearly plus tax for named regions; production/mobile POS and other add-ons separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 指定地区 Basic 年付折合每月 1,638 卢比起加税；生产、移动 POS 等另列。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Unit conversion is part of the transaction
sections.title_zh: 单位换算属于交易的一部分
sections.en:
The inventory page describes buying in cases and selling in dozens/pieces, multiple barcodes, lots/serials, bins and godowns. For a hypothetical carton containing twelve pieces, receive two cartons, sell three pieces and inspect both the piece balance and accounting value. This checks your configured conversion, not merely whether a barcode can be scanned.

Then return one item against its original sale and compare discounts, batch and customer balance. These are suggested tests. Label generation and quantity tracking do not establish compatible scanners, correct valuation or a complete audit trail in your deployment.
sections.zh:
库存页介绍按箱采购、按打或件销售，多条码、批次序列号、货位和仓库。若假设每箱十二件，收两箱再售三件，应同时检查件数余额和会计价值；这是检查所配置换算，而不只看能否扫码。

随后按原销售退一件，对照折扣、批次和客户余额。这些是建议测试，标签生成与数量跟踪不能证明扫描器兼容、计价正确或部署审计轨迹完整。

sections.title_en: Expiry and supplier claims need a complete return path
sections.title_zh: 有效期与供应商索赔需要完整退货路径
sections.en:
The product lists expiry/near-expiry billing prompts, damaged/expired inventory handling and supplier purchase returns with pending balances. It also describes landed-cost formulas and financial reports. Confirm whether a prompt warns or blocks and which roles may override it; the page does not establish one rule for every installation.

Evaluate an expired batch, a partial supplier credit and a stock discrepancy. Reconcile the physical adjustment with inventory and payables. GST/e-invoice feature labels are vendor capabilities, not independent confirmation of tax correctness or filing coverage.
sections.zh:
产品列出开票时临期到期提示、损坏过期库存处理，以及带未结余额的供应商采购退货，也介绍到岸成本公式和财务报表。需确认提示究竟警告还是阻止，谁能覆盖；页面不能确立每个安装采用同一规则。

可评估过期批次、供应商部分贷项和盘点差异，把实物调整与库存应付对清。GST 电子发票标签属于厂商能力说明，不是独立税务正确性或申报覆盖证明。

sections.title_en: Annual cloud offers and add-ons have a regional scope
sections.title_zh: 年付云方案与附加项有地区范围
sections.en:
The cloud page read on 22 October 2026 lists Basic from INR 1,638 monthly equivalent, Standard 1,879, Professional 2,071, Professional Plus 2,362, Ultimate 2,962 and Enterprise Basic 10,162, billed yearly with taxes extra. Its note limits those displayed prices to India, Bangladesh, Bhutan and Sri Lanka. The exact included license quantity was not established.

The same page separately lists mobile POS from INR 17,050 yearly and add-ons such as production at INR 28,400 yearly. Do not treat all navigated modules as included in Basic. Enterprise-Core requests contact pricing; on-premise pricing is another offer. Currency conversion, checkout and implementation cost were not tested.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的云页面列出年付折合月价印度卢比：Basic 1,638 起、Standard 1,879、Professional 2,071、Professional Plus 2,362、Ultimate 2,962、Enterprise Basic 10,162，税费另计。注释限定这些展示价格适用于印度、孟加拉国、不丹及斯里兰卡；包含多少许可未确立。

同页另列移动 POS 年费 17,050 卢比起，以及生产模块年费 28,400 等附加项，不能把所有导航模块算入 Basic。Enterprise-Core 需联系报价，本地价格另属其他方案；未测试汇率、结账或实施费。

sections.title_en: Pick the product and permission model before importing
sections.title_zh: 导入前选择产品及权限模型
sections.en:
The cloud page describes Azure hosting, license changes and integrated backup/recovery, while the family also offers on-premise products. Ask which application, locations, devices and roles are in the quote and who owns updates, exports and restore. No backup reliability or infrastructure-uptime claim was independently verified.

Prepare item units, tax defaults, opening stock, supplier/customer balances and price rules. A retailer/distributor needing those controls can investigate the fit; a generic invoicing task may not require the full family. Local statutory behavior, hardware, interfaces, source-code rights and actual transaction performance remain unverified.
sections.zh:
云页介绍 Azure 托管、许可调整和集成备份恢复，家族同时提供本地产品。应询问报价包含哪个应用、地点设备和角色，以及谁负责更新、导出恢复。本次未独立验证备份可靠性或基础设施可用率。

应准备物品单位、默认税项、期初库存、客户供应商余额和价格规则。需要这些控制的零售分销企业可以评估，普通开票任务可能无需整个家族。法定行为、硬件接口、源码权利及实际交易性能仍未核实。

research_gaps.zh: 未测试单位换算、库存移动、退货、申报、集成、导出或恢复。
